old_problem: OS/driver inventory cannot execute NVSSVT or prove 100%. Without a fixed suite manifest and policy for SKIP/UNSUPPORTED/ABORT/INFRA_ERROR, required tests can silently disappear from the denominator; selective reruns can also manufacture a clean percentage.
disposition_reason: The source clearly requires full NVSSVT system-software qualification and 100%. Suite build/configuration, software compatibility matrix and denominator policy are Project Configuration. A parameterized gate can preserve the eight-hour/full-manifest coverage and prevent PASS until every expected result is reconciled, so review need not remain Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2154, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2155 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP SW-00003-V002 / 8f5e8a81c6da09b4 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind NVSSVT package/build/license or image digest, exact L0/L1 command/configuration and a signed expected-test manifest/count.
Bind HGX firmware, OS/kernel, NVIDIA driver, CUDA, container runtime/toolkit, fabric manager and library versions to the supported matrix; no unapproved install/upgrade is implied.
Freeze PASS/FAIL/SKIP/UNSUPPORTED/ABORT/INFRA_ERROR denominator and waiver policy before execution; 100% requires the approved manifest, not a vendor summary alone.
Use an idle maintenance SUT for the full 480-minute allocation. Preserve complete per-test outputs/results and pre/during/post GPU/driver/XID/kernel/BMC/thermal/power/stack evidence.
Stop on suite hang, driver unload/reset, GPU XID, thermal/power fault, reboot, stack drift or incomplete manifest; never selectively rerun failures to change the rate.
No NVSSVT, inventory query, package/container change, log clearing, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Qualify the complete HGX system-software stack with the approved NVSSVT suite and prove a true 100% pass rate over the fixed required test population without silently excluded non-pass states.
required_package: Pinned NVSSVT package/build/license or container image digest
Exact L0/L1 command/configuration and signed expected-test manifest/count
Dedicated stable SUT, 480-minute window, artifact storage, monitoring and software rollback/recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve/hash the complete stack baseline and verify no user GPU workloads. Run only the owner-approved full NVSSVT L0/L1 configuration once for the formal 480-minute scope. Retain every per-test artifact and reconcile PASS/FAIL/SKIP/UNSUPPORTED/ABORT/INFRA_ERROR to the frozen expected manifest before calculating 100%. Do not alter the stack, clear logs or selectively retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected NVSSVT test is present and PASS under the pinned compatible stack, yielding 100% under the signed denominator; no skipped/unsupported/aborted/infrastructure-error item is silently excluded, and no disqualifying driver/GPU/platform fault or stack drift occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until suite/stack/manifest and denominator are signed. PASS requires every expected item reconciled and 100% under that policy. FAIL on any unwaived non-PASS, missing test/artifact, stack mismatch/drift, hang/reboot or disqualifying fault. Missing package/policy is BLOCKED; inventory or selective rerun cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until suite, stack matrix, manifest/denominator, duration, limits and recovery are signed.
Do not install/upgrade driver/container/runtime without separate approval and rollback.
Use an idle dedicated SUT with trusted access and continuous health monitoring.
Stop without selective or automatic retry on fault or incomplete results.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, NVSSVT package hash/image digest/license and exact configuration
Complete hardware/firmware/software inventory mapped to the supported matrix
Signed expected-test manifest/count and denominator/waiver policy
Full per-test artifacts and complete non-pass-state reconciliation with calculated rate
Abort/recovery or stable final state, no-rerun audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On hang, driver/GPU fault, reboot, stack drift or incomplete manifest, stop and preserve the original run. Follow the signed software-stack recovery/rollback; do not rerun selected tests or alter the denominator, and quarantine results until the original stack state is verified.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require NVSSVT and 100%; missing suite/accounting details are Project Configuration.

blocked.reason: Review semantics are complete; runtime remains gated on the package/configuration, compatible stack, fixed manifest/accounting and recovery.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: NVSSVT build/package/digest/license, exact suite/configuration and manifest, supported software matrix, denominator/waiver policy, maintenance/abort/storage and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; PARAMETERIZED NVSSVT GATE CLOSED; NO NVSSVT/INVENTORY, PACKAGE/CONTAINER CHANGE, LOG CLEAR, RECOVERY, SELECTIVE RERUN OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: NVIDIA software qualification, OS/driver/container/fabric and platform owners
pending.unlock_condition: Bind the signed suite/stack/manifest/accounting/recovery inputs and authorize the full maintenance run; no new review decision is required absent suite or denominator change.

external_authorities.application: Requires command-purpose fit, full formal duration, authoritative 100% accounting, complete evidence, recovery and no result-hiding retry.

project_authority: NVIDIA software owner supplies suite/manifest and supported stack; project owner approves denominator/waivers; platform owner owns rollback/recovery; engineer owns verdict.
